This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="SC2" />

==Biology and appearance==
This imposing [[species]] was distinguished by large builds and features, [[Color|green]] coloration, and hardened, spiky, armor-like skin.<ref name="SC2" />

==Species in the galaxy==
Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> one [[Unidentified greasy creature|member of this species]] was present at a noodle shop on [[Borgo Prime]], attempting to capture the [[Youngling|children]] [[Wim]] and [[Neel]] after they tried to pay for a bowl of [[Unidentified noodle dish (Port Borgo)|noodles]] with an [[Galactic Republic|Old Republic]] [[Galactic Credit Standard|credit]], before they were beaten by the [[droid]] [[SM-33]].<ref name="SC2" />

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared in the [[Way, Way Out Past the Barrier|second episode]] of the television series ''[[Skeleton Crew]]'',<ref name="SC2" /> which was released on [[December 2]], [[2024]].<ref name="Early">{{SW|url=news/skeleton-crew-premiere-date|text=''Star Wars: Skeleton Crew'' Will Debut Early|date=2024-11-26}}</ref>
